name: Next.js SaaS Starter
description: A customer-facing Next.js starter with Forge KB/spec defaults.
qualityExpectations: Write behavior-driven Forge specs before substantial product work.
Prefer a validation stack such as Playwright and Vitest as the project grows.
Keep UI code thin and move shared domain logic into reusable modules over time.
starterSteps: Install dependencies and run the local dev server in the new repo.
Create the first product capability spec before branching into multiple surfaces.
Use forge project add when the starter needs an API, worker, admin app, or shared package later.

- Start the app with `npm run dev`
- Create the first Forge spec before adding major features
